title: LOOP_V1 task packet
description: One dispatchable unit of coding work handed to a coding agent. Every field is required and the shape is closed (additionalProperties:false): a packet that omits a budget, a rollback plan, or its forbidden actions is not dispatchable. Packets live under tasks/packets/PKT-*.json.

task_id.description: Packet identifier; matches the filename stem under tasks/packets/.

objective.description: What the packet accomplishes, stated so the acceptance test can falsify it.

files_in_scope.description: Repo-relative paths the agent may create or edit. Everything else is out of bounds.

files_out_of_scope.description: Paths explicitly named as untouchable (spine files, run_state/, ui/, ...). Redundant with files_in_scope by design -- belt and braces.

preconditions.description: Shell commands that must each exit 0 before dispatch (e.g. a clean worktree check, a file-exists check).

test_cmd.description: The single shell command whose exit code decides done. Run once before work (must fail) and once after (must pass).

must_fail_before.description: Always true: a test that already passes proves nothing about the change (rule 4 -- validations are never coerced, including vacuous ones).

max_attempts.description: Dispatch attempts before the packet escalates to the human.

max_diff_lines.description: Cap on added+removed lines in the produced diff (inviolate rule 8: bounded codegen).

forbidden_actions.description: Actions the agent must not take (e.g. 'git push', 'edit files outside files_in_scope', 'install packages').

branch_delete.description: Whether failure cleanup is simply deleting the work branch.

notes.description: Any manual rollback steps beyond branch deletion; empty string when none.
